title: CI Pull Request Recovery exact checkout provenance

phases.objective: Bind Recovery test progress artifacts to the exact Git tree actually checked out and executed instead of allowing an event-level pull-request merge SHA to label a head-SHA test result.

e2e_journeys.actor: CI evidence publisher and repository reviewer
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: CI Pull Request Recovery Unit & Integration Tests job
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The test suite starts only after the checked-out SHA matches the selected candidate and its structured progress reports expose that same checked-out SHA through the process-local GITHUB_SHA value.
steps: Checkout the selected pull-request head SHA or explicit workflow-dispatch SHA.
Resolve git rev-parse HEAD immediately before the test suite.
Reject any mismatch between the checked-out SHA and the selected candidate SHA.
Run npm test with process-local GITHUB_SHA bound to the verified checked-out SHA.
Upload ordered test progress reports without relabeling head execution as a different merge candidate.
assertions: Recovery reports cannot inherit a different event-level GITHUB_SHA after exact-head checkout.
A candidate identity mismatch fails before npm test.
No repository write, protected-ref mutation, provider call, deployment, database action, migration, credential access, or external send is introduced.
The workflow retains read-only contents permission.

phases.objective: Publish the verified checkout identity as an explicit typed field across all recovery evidence families.
Prove identity preservation across reruns, workflow dispatch, pull-request synchronize events, and cancelled/restarted jobs.
This CI evidence correction has no provider canary authority.
This CI evidence correction grants no Production or deployment authority.
